description: This file defines the class VtigerCRMObjectMeta, which provides metadata and access control functionalities for CRM entities within the vtiger CRM system, including methods for access checks, retrieving entity fields, and meta information.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta
classes.description: A class extending EntityMeta to manage metadata, access permissions, and entity-specific operations for CRM objects in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta
methods.description: Constructor method initializing metadata for specific CRM modules based on webserviceObject and user.

methods.name: getTabId
methods.description: Returns the tab id of the current CRM module, fetched via vtlib function.

methods.name: getEffectiveTabId
methods.description: Returns the effective tab id, considering special cases like 'Calendar'.

methods.name: getTabName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module, mapping 'Events' to 'Calendar'.

methods.name: computeAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions based on user privileges, module activity, and profile permissions.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to the module, returning the precomputed $hasAccess.

methods.name: hasWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has write permissions for the module.

methods.name: hasReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has read permissions for the module.

methods.name: hasDeleteAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has delete permissions for the module.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific operation on a given webservice ID.

methods.name: hasAssignPrivilege
methods.description: Verifies if the user has assign privileges for a specific webservice entity.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleColumns
methods.description: Returns columns the user has access to, retrieving meta if necessary.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Returns module fields, retrieving meta if necessary.

methods.name: getColumnTableMapping
methods.description: Returns column to table mapping, retrieving meta if necessary.

methods.name: getFieldColumnMapping
methods.description: Generates and returns the mapping of field names to column names.

methods.name: getMandatoryFields
methods.description: Returns mandatory fields, ensuring meta is loaded first.

methods.name: getReferenceFieldDetails
methods.description: Retrieves reference field details post meta retrieval.

methods.name: getOwnerFields
methods.description: Returns owner fields after ensuring meta is loaded.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity.

methods.name: getEmailFields
methods.description: Returns email fields, available after meta retrieval.

methods.name: getFieldIdFromFieldName
methods.description: Returns the field ID for a given field name.

methods.name: retrieveMeta
methods.description: Loads the metadata for the module, including custom view info and fields.

methods.name: retrieveUserHierarchy
methods.description: Loads user hierarchy and groups for assign privileges.

methods.name: retrieveMetaForBlock
methods.description: Retrieves meta info for specific fields blocks and populates module fields with WebserviceField objects.

methods.name: getObjectEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity type/name for a given webservice ID.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a record with the specified ID exists in the database.

methods.name: getNameFields
methods.description: Returns the name fields for the entity, used for display.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of an entity given its webservice ID.

methods.name: getEntityAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Provides the access control SQL query for entities, excluding 'Users'.

methods.name: getJoinClause
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN clause for related tables.

methods.name: isModuleEntity
methods.description: Indicates whether this class represents a module entity, returning true.
